programme.desc: Each episode gives viewers an inside look at television, film and music, including interviews with each industry's biggest stars. In addition to covering breaking news, the show visits sets of movies and TV shows and heads to the red carpet to cover awards shows and other major events. Airing daily since 1981, "Entertainment Tonight" is the template by which many other entertainment newsmagazines are based.
